scientific_integrity: The theorem is proven using cyclotomic coefficient comparison, finite Fourier inversion, and subgroup Möbius inversion; the checker makes only finite integer-exact tests.
scientific_limitations: The prime-fiber coprimality and graph hypotheses are essential. No claim for composite fiber orders or all subsets. Previously unindexed equivalent work remains a priority risk. Finite verification does not replace proof.
title: Period rigidity and exact spectrum multiplicities for cyclic prime-fiber graphs
